==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson, Gold Wielder, and I are in a clearing. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The Gold Trident Wielder is a flying, sparkling golden, faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, golden trident.)
A giant colorful bird with a pink dinosaur head and a legless boulder monster charge at us from a red archway in the forest.
I use geomancy to slam the boulder monster into the strange bird thing to defeat them both with one move.
